summary: Completed Module 03 Step 4 VERIFY: verified route separation tradeoffs, HTTP status code semantics (400 vs 200/500), and expired link handling (410 Gone vs 404 Not Found).
evidence: Demonstrated architectural separation of public redirects from admin endpoints for CDN edge routing and zero-overhead performance.
Explained HTTP 400 semantics preventing alert fatigue and client misinterpretation caused by 200-OK-with-error or 500-internal-error anti-patterns.
Defined expired link protocol behavior: emitting HTTP 410 Gone / 404 without Location headers to prevent dangling redirects.
